findings.problem: The hint rules out eben and einfach but not nun mal, and "Das ist nun mal so" is just as common and correct for this prompt.
findings.fix: hint: shrugging particle, one word: it can't be helped (not eben, einfach or nun mal)

back.target: just, simply (a modal particle of resignation: that's the way it is, it can't be helped)
back.example: That's just the way it is, you can't do anything about it.

note: Halt is used even more in Austria and Switzerland than in Germany, so regional null is right because those countries don't use a different word.
